audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every model call, tool call, file or network access, and memory change recorded by the local runtime. Newest first.

audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.
audit.argumentsRedacted: Tool arguments are withheld: they can contain secrets. The audit store still records the call.
audit.exported: Exported {{count}} entries with an Ed25519 signature to {{path}}.
audit.verified: Signature valid: {{count}} entries, exported {{time}}. Signed by this installation.
audit.retentionBody: Entries older than the chosen age are deleted permanently. Export them first if you may need them.
audit.prunedNone: No audit entries were old enough to delete.
audit.verifiedOther: Signature valid: {{count}} entries, exported {{time}}. Signed by a different installation.
audit.autoRetentionHint: On startup and every six hours, delete audit entries older than the selected limit. Saving a limit removes older entries immediately.
audit.policyForeverSaved: Automatic cleanup is off; entries are kept forever.
audit.backupDesc: Signed audit backups on a schedule. The first backup is a full snapshot; later runs add entries since the last success. A due backup runs before automatic retention deletes anything.

notifications.desc: Show a system notification when a new approval, question, failed office item, or budget alert appears. Notifications are sent only while RAVENBOT is in the background.

notifications.question: Question waiting

notifications.webhookHttps: Only HTTPS URLs are accepted. The URL is stored in the OS keychain when available.
notifications.emailDesc: Send generic attention alerts over SMTP. Prompts, questions, secrets, and budget amounts are never included.
notifications.emailPasswordHint: Leave blank to keep the saved password.
notifications.emailTls: STARTTLS is required for a remote host. Plain SMTP is allowed only for loopback. The password is stored in the OS keychain when available.
